risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI & Autonomous Technologies Transparency, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to AI Output / Decision Integrity Failure (R-AI-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior (MT-13).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to develop applications based on Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP).
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP) (TDA-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Transparency (AAT-24.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Secure Engineering Principles
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of industry-recognized security, compliance and resilience practices in the specification, design, development, implementation and modification of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_2.justification: Secure Engineering Principles (SEA-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of AI & Autonomous Technologies Transparency (AAT-24.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
